facts.text: Mile End sits in Montreal’s Plateau Mont‑Royal borough, east of Mount Royal, and is famed for its independent boutiques, vintage shops, bakeries, and cafés.
Drawn & Quarterly, the comic‑book publisher, was founded in Mile End in 1989, making the neighborhood a birthplace of indie comics.
Mile End’s history is marked by waves of immigrants, from Jewish and Italian communities to contemporary artists and tech workers.
The neighborhood nurtures creative talent, hosting musicians, filmmakers, writers, illustrators, and computer‑game developers who shape Montreal’s cultural scene.
The Mordecai‑Richler Library, a converted church on Mile End’s western edge, offers a quiet spot for readers and history buffs alike.
